channel.title: GST law — data updates
channel.description: Every data refresh shipped to the GST law app.

item.title: GSTN advisory: Sept 2026 GST revenue collections
gst-rates: don't claim a single GST 2.0 rate change for a multi-item entry (HSN 8703 compound vehicle entries)
gst-rates: fix 8 wrong 2017-citation mismatches (ambulances etc.); period-correct wording for the RATE HISTORY jump

Case law: Mercedes-Benz India v. Union of India (Bombay High Court, 2025 — ground clearance for compensation cess on SUVs) added to Cess section 8; Munjaal Manishbhai Bhatt now records the pending Supreme Court appeal, SLP (C) No. 21703 of 2022

Section and rule references in Integrated / Union Territory Tax notifications that name no Act now open the right one (UTGST s.22, IGST ss.5, 12 and 13, the IGST Rules' own rules 2-5); other statutes' sections, Gazette "Part-I, Section 1" lines and sub-section numbers written without brackets no longer link into CGST

Section references in notifications, circulars and orders now open the right Act: "the said Act" follows each document's own definition (IGST / UTGST sections no longer open CGST ones; Finance Act commencement sections no longer link into CGST)
Notifications: the Scheme of Classification's own "Section 5"-"Section 9" (annexure to 11/2017-CT(R) and the 2017 rate / exemption schedules) no longer link to CGST sections 5-9

Rate finder: the 2017-2025 rate histories read from every amendment (tiles, paints, plywood, lifts cut to 18% in 2017-18; EV chargers, fertilisers, cartons), Nil since 2017 for goods exempt from the start, TMT bars (7214) found, and the pure-labour exemption under SAC 9954
Real estate sector hub: 4 new case notes (JDA, TDR, RWA), construction rate labels corrected
Circulars, notifications, instructions and orders: paragraphs no longer run together (lettered/roman sub-paragraphs, long numbered lists, sub-section references)
67 landmark rulings with outcome filters, case-law and guide updates, law changes to date carried through; data schema 2 (needs vc20 or later)
Case-law verification pass (22 case notes now carry a verified date) and corrected search text for a few statute passages
GSTN advisory 672 (19 Sep 2026) — emSigner v3.3 for digital-signature tokens issued from 21 Sep 2026
GSTN advisory 671 (7 Sep 2026) — appeal in APL-01 now enabled for NIL / Zero demand orders
Add Amit Cotton Industries v. Principal Commissioner (Guj HC 2019) to Rule 96; Rule 96(10) omission note
Add the Case law browser dataset; enrichment case notes gain stable ids
Add SC ruling: State of Jharkhand v. BLA Infrastructure — pre-deposit refund after a won appeal is governed by s.107(6) r/w s.115, not s.54
Initial data package — corpus as of 2026-09-03 (incl. GSTN advisory #670)
